datasets.title: Sudan Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2020
datasets.description: Sudan Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2020. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/sudan_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (monthly) field assessments across Sudan during 2020 to classify acute food insecurity using the IPC framework. Classification results were spatially mapped by administrative unit and scenario, with data collected from February through December 2020 and distributed in GeoJSON and KML formats.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity severity and affected populations across Sudan.
